name: Keshon Gilbert
short_comment: Gilbert didn't play in Thursday's 123-116 preseason win over the Spurs due to left patella tendinitis, Lauren L. Williams of The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports.
long_comment: Gilbert appeared in Atlanta's first preseason matchup Monday against Memphis, but he was unable to go Thursday. He can be considered day-to-day moving forward.

name: Luguentz Dort
short_comment: Dort (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason matchup with San Antonio, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
long_comment: Dort will remain on the shelf for a second straight preseason game due to a right knee contusion. His next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come against the Pacers on Saturday.

name: Jalen Johnson
short_comment: Johnson (rest) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against San Antonio, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
long_comment: Johnson will sit out Atlanta's second preseason game after posting eight points (1-7 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 6-6 FT), five rebounds, three assists and one steal in 18 minutes during Monday's loss to Memphis. His next chance to play in the preseason will come against Indiana on Saturday.

name: Henri Veesaar
short_comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
long_comment: Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.

name: Mouhamed Gueye
short_comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
long_comment: Gueye will be re-evaluated by medical staff in 3-to-4 months, which means he'll miss all of training camp and preseason and likely the start of the 2026-27 regular season. It's a brutal blow for the fourth-year big man, given that the Hawks used the No. 23 overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft to select St. John's product Zuby Ejiofor. Gueye's absence means Ejiofor will have more opportunities in the preseason, and the rookie could establish a key role off the bench behind Onyeka Okongwu and projected backup center Jock Landale (ankle).

name: Sam Hauser
short_comment: Hauser (rest) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
long_comment: The Celtics are resting several players ahead of this preseason game, and that includes Hauser, who's expected to have a sizable role in the rotation this season. His next chance to play will come against the 76ers on Saturday.

name: Ron Harper Jr.
short_comment: Harper (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
long_comment: It's unclear why Harper won't suit up for Boston's preseason opener. His next opportunity to play will come in Saturday's preseason game against Philadelphia.

name: Payton Pritchard
short_comment: Pritchard (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
long_comment: This appears to be a scheduled rest day for Pritchard, as the Celtics are sitting a number of their regular rotation players. He'll have an opportunity to suit up for Saturday's exhibition against the 76ers.

name: Mitchell Robinson
short_comment: Robinson (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
long_comment: Robinson will join several other rotation players on the sidelines for Boston's preseason opener. The big man's next chance to play in the preseason will come Saturday against the 76ers.

name: Neemias Queta
short_comment: Queta (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday against Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.
long_comment: Boston seems to be holding out their expected starters for this exhibition. Luka Garza is getting a chance to start at center for the Celtics on Thursday.

name: Paul George
short_comment: George (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday versus Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.
long_comment: The Celtics are holding several key contributors out of the starting lineup Thursday. Jordan Walsh is drawing the start at power forward.

name: Jayson Tatum
short_comment: Tatum (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday against Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.
long_comment: Boston looks to be resting their starters for this exhibition. Hugo Gonzalez is starting at small forward Thursday.

name: Derrick White
short_comment: White (rest) isn't in line to play Thursday against Cleveland, Zack Cox of the Boston Herald reports.
long_comment: The Celtics appear to be resting their starters for this exhibition. Mike Conley is starting at point guard Thursday.

name: Joshua Jefferson
short_comment: Jefferson (back) will not play in Thursday's preseason game against the 76ers, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
long_comment: Jefferson will miss his second consecutive preseason contest after sitting out Tuesday's win over Charlotte. The rookie forward's return timeline remains unclear, and the missed time could limit his opportunities to compete for a rotation role ahead of the regular season.

name: Mikel Brown Jr.
short_comment: Brown (ankle) will miss Thursday's preseason game against Philadelphia, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
long_comment: Brown also missed Tuesday's preseason opener against Charlotte and has been working his way back into basketball activities after suffering the injury during training camp. Brooklyn has been cautious with the rookie guard's recovery, and he remains without a firm timetable for his preseason debut.

name: Day'Ron Sharpe
short_comment: Sharpe has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason matchup against Philadelphia due to left shoulder soreness, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
long_comment: The severity of Sharpe's shoulder issue remains unclear, though the team is likely being cautious for this exhibition. His absence could create additional frontcourt opportunities for Brooklyn's other big men during Thursday's contest.

name: Michael Porter Jr.
short_comment: Porter will not play in Thursday's preseason game against Philadelphia due to left wrist soreness, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
long_comment: Porter's absence comes after he scored 16 points in Tuesday's preseason win over Charlotte. The Nets haven't indicated whether the wrist issue will affect his availability beyond Thursday, though his next opportunity to play will come in Brooklyn's next exhibition contest.

name: Brandon Miller
short_comment: Miller (leg) is listed as out for Tuesday's preseason game versus the Nets.
long_comment: Miller suffered a shin contusion during Tuesday's practice. Although there haven't been further details, his absence against the Nets is likely precautionary. The 23-year-old ended the 2025-26 campaign by averaging 20.2 points, 4.9 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 1.0 steals while shooting a career-high 38.3 percent from deep over 30.3 minutes per contest in 65 regular-season games.

name: Christian Anderson
short_comment: Anderson (ankle) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nets.
long_comment: The Hornets are taking a cautious approach with the rookie first-rounder, who suffered an ankle sprain in practice. His next chance to play comes Sunday against the Bucks.

name: Kylan Boswell
short_comment: Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.
long_comment: It doesn't sound like the two-way guard will be available for the preseason, but he's hopeful to not miss any time during the G League season. Boswell is not expected to be a significant part of the Hornets' rotation this season.

name: Coby White
short_comment: The Hornets announced Monday that White suffered a left calf strain during training camp and will not play during the preseason.
long_comment: White missed time with a left calf strain last season and is now in jeopardy of starting the regular season on the inactive list. If the 26-year-old guard is forced to miss time beyond the preseason, Christian Anderson and Dennis Schroder would likely see increased playing time.

name: Kon Knueppel
short_comment: Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that he "doesn't know" whether Knueppel (hamstring) will be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Nets, Owen Watterson of SI.com reports.
long_comment: Knueppel's status for Opening Night remains uncertain as he continues to work his way back from his left hamstring injury. Peterson's comments suggest the Hornets aren't ready to rule out the second-year wing, though his availability will likely become clearer as training camp progresses. He has already been ruled out for the entire preseason, to be clear.

name: Grant Williams
short_comment: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.
long_comment: Williams will be re-evaluated the first week of the regular season, putting his status for Opening Night in the air. Williams will have a difficult path to minutes this season as he competes with the likes of Naz Reid, Royce O'Neale and Tidjane Salaun.

name: Zach Collins
short_comment: Collins (toe) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Suns, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
long_comment: Collins will remain sidelined for the Bulls' preseason opener, though head coach Tiago Splitter said he's close to returning, per Johnson. Collins' next chance to play in the preseason will come Friday against Memphis.

name: Jaylin Sellers
short_comment: Sellers (back) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Suns, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
long_comment: Sellers is dealing with a bout of lower-back soreness. The two-way player's next chance to play is Friday against Memphis.

name: Tre Jones
short_comment: Jones won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Suns, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
long_comment: Jones will he held out of Chicago's preseason opener. The 26-year-old guard's next opportunity to play will come in Friday's preseason matchup with the Grizzlies.

name: Nic Claxton
short_comment: Claxton tweaked his hamstring and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Chuck Swirsky of the Bulls Radio Network of the Bulls Radio Network reports.
long_comment: This is a huge blow for Claxton and it rules him out for the entire preseason. For now, fantasy managers can consider him questionable for Opening Night on Oct. 21 against the Raptors. Jalen Smith is the next man up on the depth chart for Chicago, followed by Zach Collins (toe).

name: Khalifa Diop
short_comment: Diop (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against Boston, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
long_comment: Diop will sit out the Cavaliers' preseason opener for undisclosed reasons. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Sunday against the Magic.

name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
short_comment: Tomlin (back) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against Boston, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
long_comment: Tomlin is dealing with lower-back soreness and will be held out of Cleveland's preseason opener. His next chance to suit up in the preseason will come Sunday against Orlando.

name: James Harden
short_comment: Harden (ankle) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Celtics, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
long_comment: Harden is dealing with right ankle soreness and will be held out of Cleveland's preseason opener. With the veteran guard sidelined, Jaylon Tyson will join Donovan Mitchell, Peyton Watson, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen in the starting five.

name: Marcus Sasser
short_comment: Sasser won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets due to left adductor soreness.
long_comment: Sasser is competing for a bench role ahead of the 2026-27 season, and he's showing early on why he deserves a spot in the rotation, though missing time won't help his cause. Sasser averaged 5.2 points, 1.0 rebounds and 2.0 assists in 38 regular-season appearances a season ago in Detroit before joining Dallas in June as part of a six-team trade.

name: P.J. Washington
short_comment: Washington won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets.
long_comment: The severity of Washington's ankle injury is unclear, but his next chance to suit up will come during Sunday's rematch against the Rockets in China. The veteran forward is expected to have a key role for the Mavs heading into the 2026-27 season, though coach Dusty May isn't ready to commit to the Kentucky product as a mainstay in the starting five. It's worth noting that Washington has come off the bench only four times in 113 regular-season appearances for Dallas over the last two years.

name: Caleb Martin
short_comment: Martin won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rocket due to an illness.
long_comment: Martin's next chance to suit up will come during Sunday's rematch against the Rockets in China. The veteran forward enters 2026-27 as part of a crowded Dallas wing rotation, which could make consistent playing time difficult to secure.

name: Dereck Lively II
short_comment: Lively (foot) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets.
long_comment: Mavericks president Masai Ujiri said that Lively has progressed to shooting and is working toward running on the court, though Dallas intends to remain patient with the 22-year-old. Lively underwent right foot surgery in December after appearing in just seven regular-season games in 2025-26, averaging 4.3 points, 5.3 rebounds, 1.9 assists and 1.6 blocks in 16.4 minutes per game. He has yet to be cleared for training camp, and his status for the regular season remains uncertain.

name: Santi Aldama
short_comment: Aldama (knee) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets.
long_comment: Aldama underwent knee surgery in March and has been limited during training camp practices. It's unclear when he'll be cleared to make his Mavericks debut. The 2021 No. 30 overall pick had spent his entire career in Memphis before being traded to Dallas in July 2026. In 278 regular-season games, including 82 starts, he has averaged 10.4 points, 5.4 rebounds and 2.1 assists over 23.4 minutes per contest.

name: Spencer Jones
short_comment: Jones (hamstring) participated in on-court work after Thursday's practice, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.
long_comment: It's unclear how much of Thursday's practice Jones took part in, though it's encouraging to see him doing on-court work. The 25-year-old forward tweaked his hamstring early in training camp and has missed each of the team's first two preseason games. Although Jones is considered day-to-day, the Nuggets may continue exercising caution ahead of their regular-season opener against the Thunder on Thursday, Oct. 22.

name: Jalen Duren
short_comment: Duren (rest) is expected to play at some point this preseason, per Hunter Patterson of The Athletic.
long_comment: After Duren engaged in a long standoff regarding contract negotiations with Detroit, the Pistons are monitoring the big man's reps as he ramps up his activity at training camp. His next chance to see exhibition action comes Saturday in Washington.

name: Gui Santos
short_comment: Santos (rest) won't travel with the Warriors for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
long_comment: Santos started Tuesday's 124-98 preseason win over the Lakers and remains in the mix for a significant role after starting 30 games during the 2025-26 regular season. Golden State is holding several rotation players out for the second half of a preseason back-to-back, and Santos should have another opportunity to suit up Saturday against Sacramento.

name: Brandin Podziemski
short_comment: Podziemski (rest) won't travel with the Warriors for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
long_comment: Podziemski is coming off a strong showing in Tuesday's 124-98 preseason win over the Lakers, finishing with 16 points (7-11 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 1-2 FT), two rebounds, one assist, one steal and one block in 19 minutes. Golden State is resting several rotation players on the second half of a preseason back-to-back, and Podziemski should have another opportunity to suit up Saturday against Sacramento.

name: Gary Payton II
short_comment: Payton (rest) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
long_comment: Payton is among several rotation players Golden State is holding out Wednesday during a preseason back-to-back. The veteran guard remains in the mix for a reserve role after appearing in a career-high 73 games during the 2025-26 regular season.

name: Georges Niang
short_comment: Niang (rest) won't travel with the Warriors for Wednesday's preseason game against Portland, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
long_comment: Niang is among several Warriors rotation players who will remain home for the second half of a preseason back-to-back. The veteran forward has been working primarily with Golden State's second unit during training camp and should have another opportunity to play Saturday against Sacramento.

name: De'Anthony Melton
short_comment: Melton (rest) won't travel with the Warriors for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
long_comment: Melton is among several rotation players Golden State is holding out for the second half of a preseason back-to-back. The veteran guard has been working with the Warriors' second unit during training camp and should have another opportunity to suit up Saturday against Sacramento.

name: Yaxel Lendeborg
short_comment: Lendeborg (rest) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
long_comment: The rookie is one of several Warriors not making the trip for maintenance reasons. He produced  17 points (7-11 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 1-2 FT), nine rebounds and two assists across 21 minutes in Tuesday's 124-98 preseason win over the Lakers and continues to impress the coaching staff.

name: Stephen Curry
short_comment: Curry generated 16 points, 4-7 FG, 3-6 3Pt, 5-6 FT), five assists and two rebounds across 14 minutes in Tuesday's 124-98 preseason win over the Lakers.
long_comment: Curry made the most of his limited court time, drilling three shots beyond the arc in short order. Curry won't travel with the team to Portland, and the veteran's preseason participation is expected to be very limited to avoid injury and keep him fresh for the regular season.

name: Draymond Green
short_comment: Green will be limited to around 20 minutes in Tuesday's preseason contest against the Lakers and won't travel to Portland for Wednesday's back-to-back against the Trail Blazers, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
long_comment: The Warriors are being cautious with Green's workload in the preseason, so he'll be limited to around 20 minutes Tuesday and won't suit up Wednesday. This is part of a long-term picture, as the idea is to have Green as healthy as possible for the start of the regular season against the Lakers on Oct. 21.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
short_comment: Porzingis (undisclosed) remains out indefinitely, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
long_comment: The Warriors still aren't ready to offer up a return timeline for Porzingis, who's battling an undisclosed issue. The big man carries plenty of upside on a per-game basis in the later rounds of fantasy drafts, but he's reached the 60-game mark just one time in the past eight regular seasons.

name: Jimmy Butler III
short_comment: The Warriors hope to have Butler (knee) back early in 2027, per Keith Watkins of Yahoo Sports.
long_comment: Butler is still months away from retaking the floor, according to Nick Friedell of The Athletic, so a season debut at some point December might be too optimistic. The star forward remains without a definitive timeline for a return after undergoing ACL surgery in early February, which typically carries at least a nine-month recovery period. Butler makes sense as an injury stash at the end of fantasy drafts, but managers should likely be bracing for him to miss at least the first two months of the regular season.

name: Moses Moody
short_comment: Moody has progressed to light on-court activities as he continues his recovery from a ruptured left patellar tendon, Evan Webeck of The Mercury News reports.
long_comment: Moody suffered the injury March 23 and underwent season-ending surgery four days later. The 24-year-old had been targeting September to resume running and on-court work, so his latest progress appears to keep his rehabilitation on track, though he remains without a firm timetable for his return to game action.

name: Kevin Durant
short_comment: Durant will not play in Sunday's preseason rematch against Dallas, Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports. The forward finished Friday's preseason contest with 15 points (7-12 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 0-1 FT), two assists and one block in 23 minutes.
long_comment: According to coach Ime Udoka, Durant was initially scheduled to play only the first half Friday but requested additional minutes to build chemistry with Fred VanVleet and his other new teammates. The veteran forward's absence Sunday appears to be a planned precaution rather than an injury-related setback, and Houston should have additional minutes available for its other wings and forwards

name: Larry Nance Jr.
short_comment: Nance (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against Minnesota, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
long_comment: The Pacers are allowing the veteran center to recover from a hamstring injury. His next chance to play is Saturday against the Hawks.

name: T.J. McConnell
short_comment: McConnell (undisclosed) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Minnesota, per Tony East of Forbes.com.
long_comment: It's possible that the Pacers are resting the veteran point guard. Saturday's meeting with the Hawks is his next chance to make his preseason debut.

name: Johnny Furphy
short_comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
long_comment: Furphy started in 21 of 35 regular-season appearances for the Pacers, posting averages of 5.1 points, 4.4 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 0.7 three-pointers in 18.4 minutes per contest. While no timetable has been announced, Furphy's absence could extend through the beginning of the 2026-27 season. With this news, the Pacers will likely lean more on Ben Sheppard, Kam Jones and Quenton Jackson moving forward.

name: Kobe Sanders
short_comment: Sanders (hip) was limited to individual player development work and did not take part in five-on-five activity Wednesday, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Sanders is day-to-day.
long_comment: With Sanders having already missed the Clippers' preseason opener due to a left hip impingement, his continued limitations in practice suggest he still isn't back to full activity. The day-to-day designation keeps him in play to suit up at some point this preseason, but his availability for upcoming exhibition action remains uncertain until he resumes five-on-five work.

name: Bradley Beal
short_comment: Beal (knee) isn't participating in five-on-five work and is doing individual player development work, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Wednesday that Beal is continuing to have inflammation managed.
long_comment: With Beal already set to miss the start of training camp, it sounds like the veteran guard still hasn't progressed to full-contact work. His continued knee inflammation keeps his ramp-up timeline uncertain and suggests the Clippers will continue to manage his workload in camp.

name: Max Strus
short_comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
long_comment: Plantar fascia injuries can be tricky to recover from, with the only remedy typically being prolonged rest, so don't be surprised if Strus' absence extends well beyond this initial four-week window. With Strus now set to miss at least the first few weeks of the season, and Bradley Beal (knee) uncertain for opening night, Keaton Wagler could be thrust into the first unit sooner than expected.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
short_comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
long_comment: Niederhauser is progressing from March surgery but won't be able to suit up to begin the year. The Clippers are likely to take a cautious approach with the 2025 first-rounder. Isaiah Jackson should occupy the backup center spot behind Brook Lopez early in the campaign.

name: Brandon Ingram
short_comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.
long_comment: The Clippers learned about the injury this summer, though it's unclear exactly how far along Ingram is in his recovery. The star forward's timeline for a return is unclear, clouding his fantasy outlook in the meantime. Darius Garland should take on all the usage he can handle in Ingram's stead, while Kris Dunn and Max Strus could have additional streaming appeal early in the year.

name: Jordan Miller
short_comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
long_comment: It's a tough break for Miller, who had an opportunity to battle for a reserve role during training camp in the fall. The timeline for a return is likely to keep him on the shelf until after the All-Star break. Miller's extended stay on the sidelines gives Kobe Sanders a chance to crack the Clippers' rotation.

name: Dalton Knecht
short_comment: Knecht won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings due to a contusion, Mike Trudell of Spectrum SportsNet reports.
long_comment: Knecht is dealing with an undisclosed contusion. His next opportunity to take the floor will come in Tuesday's preseason meeting with the Warriors.

name: Walker Kessler
short_comment: Kessler (finger) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.
long_comment: Kessler will miss a third consecutive contest due to a finger injury, though head coach JJ Redick isn't concerned that it's a long-term issue, per Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com. The big man's next opportunity to play in the preseason will come Tuesday against the Warriors.

name: Collin Sexton
short_comment: Sexton (lower body) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against Sacramento, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.
long_comment: Sexton has been battling a lower-body injury and will miss his third matchup of the preseason. However, the team isn't overly concerned at this point for what coach JJ Redick is deeming a minor injury for the 27-year-old guard, per Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com.

name: Arthur Kaluma
short_comment: Kaluma (lower body) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.
long_comment: Kaluma is set to miss a third straight preseason game, and while head coach JJ Redick said he's not worried about any long-term injury, it's concerning that Kaluma hasn't logged a single minute in the preseason. His next chance to suit up will come against the Warriors on Tuesday.

name: Ziaire Williams
short_comment: Williams (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.
long_comment: Williams was also held out for the second half of a preseason back-to-back Tuesday, and he'll take a seat again Thursday with coach JJ Redick indicating a number of Lakers are dealing with minor injuries, per Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com. Williams' next opportunity to return will arrive Tuesday against Golden State.

name: Cameron Carr
short_comment: Carr (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.
long_comment: Carr and several other players are reportedly dealing with minor injuries, per Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com, but the Lakers aren't concerned about him missing any regular-season action. His next chance to play will arrive Tuesday against the Warriors.

name: Micah Peavy
short_comment: Peavy (ankle) did not play in Wednesday's 122-118 preseason loss to the Magic.
long_comment: This was Peavy's second straight game on the sidelines, and it's unclear if he'll play during the preseason. His next chance to suit up will come Friday in Chicago.

name: Isaiah Stewart
short_comment: Stewart (ankle) didn't participate in Tuesday's practice and will not play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Magic, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.
long_comment: Stewart is still being evaluated after sustaining a left ankle injury in Monday's preseason-opening win over the Hawks. The big man's next opportunity to play in the preseason will come against the Bulls on Friday.

name: Kylor Kelley
short_comment: Kelley (calf) signed a contract with the Heat on Thursday, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
long_comment: Kelley made 31 appearances with the G League's South Bay Lakers a season ago, averaging 8.0 points, 7.1 rebounds, 1.5 assists and 2.1 blocks in 25.5 minutes per game. He's earned himself an opportunity with the Heat following Thursday's signing, though he'll presumably end up being waived and head to the G League once again before the start of the 2026-27 campaign.

name: Pelle Larsson
short_comment: Larsson (illness) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Pelicans, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
long_comment: Larsson was previously expected to play after missing Wednesday's practice with an illness, though he's since been ruled out. His next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come Saturday against Minnesota.

name: Keshad Johnson
short_comment: Johnson (hamstring) is practicing in a limited fashion, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.
long_comment: Johnson doesn't sound to be a candidate for preseason reps, but it's encouraging to hear he's progressing in his hamstring recovery. A two-way player, Johnson will likely be shuttled to the G League's Sioux Falls Skyforce once healthy later this fall.

name: Dru Smith
short_comment: Smith will miss a couple weeks with a strained right calf, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
long_comment: This is a tough blow for the point guard who was penciled in as the top backup behind Davion Mitchell. If he indeed misses a couple weeks, he could be back in time for their final preseason contest Oct. 16.

name: Nate Ament
short_comment: Ament won't return to Wednesday's preseason game against the Thunder due to a left ankle sprain. He'll finish with three points (1-7 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 1-4 FT), four rebounds, one assist and one steal in 10 minutes.
long_comment: Ament landed awkwardly on his left ankle and exited to the locker room near the end of the first half. His next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come Sunday against the Hornets, though it wouldn't be surprising to see the Bucks exercise caution moving forward.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
short_comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
long_comment: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.

name: Dejounte Murray
short_comment: Murray (toe) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Heat, Andrew Lopez of Gulf Coast Sports & Entertainment Network reports.
long_comment: Murray is dealing with a right toe contusion, though head coach Jamahl Mosley said his absence Thursday is precautionary. The veteran point guard's next chance to play in the preseason will come Wednesday against Dallas.

name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
short_comment: McCullar (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Wizards but is in line to suit up for Monday's preseason matchup with Minnesota, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.
long_comment: While it's unclear exactly why McCullar isn't suiting up, it doesn't appear to be an injury-related decision. The two-way player is once again expected to spend most of his time with the G League's Westchester Knicks in 2026-27.

name: Tony Bradley
short_comment: Bradley (rest) is not in line to play in Thursday's preseason game against Wizards, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.
long_comment: The Knicks plan to keep Bradley out Thursday. His next chance to play would be Monday against Minnesota.

name: Ochai Agbaji
short_comment: Agbaji (coach's decision) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against Washington, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.
long_comment: The Knicks are holding out some of their players on non-guaranteed deals Thursday. According to Bondy, Agbaji will play in Monday's preseason game against the Timberwolves.

name: Drew Eubanks
short_comment: Eubanks (rest) is not in line to play in Thursday's preseason game against Wizards, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.
long_comment: The Knicks plan to hold Eubanks out Thursday. His next chance to play would be Monday against Minnesota.

name: Thomas Sorber
short_comment: Sorber (knee) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
long_comment: Sorber remains a limited participant in training camp following September 2025 knee surgery. His next chance to make his preseason debut is Monday against the Hawks.

name: Chet Holmgren
short_comment: Holmgren (quadriceps) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Milwaukee, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
long_comment: It's unknown how severe the quad contusion is, though Holmgren is likely being held out for precautionary reasons. With Isaiah Hartenstein (ankle) and Jaylin Williams (heel) also sidelined against the Bucks, Aday Mara may make another start.

name: Nikola Topic
short_comment: Topic (back) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
long_comment: Topic is still ramping up after undergoing back surgery in mid-June, and he'll miss a second straight preseason game. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Monday against the Hawks.

name: Isaiah Hartenstein
short_comment: Hartenstein (ankle) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
long_comment: Hartenstein is sitting out once again with ankle soreness after missing the Thunder's preseason opener. His next chance for exhibition action is Monday against the Hawks.

name: Jaylin Williams
short_comment: Williams (heel) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
long_comment: Williams is one of several regular rotation players who won't be suiting up Wednesday. His absence will give rookie Aday Mara more minutes, and the Spaniard turned heads in Tuesday's game against the Lakers. Williams' next chance to play in the preseason will come against the Hawks on Monday, Oct. 12.

name: Noah Penda
short_comment: Penda (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's preseason game in Memphis, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
long_comment: Penda has been working his way back from a hamstring injury, and while he was able to participate in Sunday's practice, he's not quite ready for game-time action. His next chance to play will come Sunday in Cleveland.

name: Anthony Black
short_comment: Black (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Grizzlies, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
long_comment: Black is still ramping up due to a sprained right ankle, though he was able to participate in Sunday's practice. His next opportunity to play in the preseason will come Sunday against Cleveland.

name: Jalen Suggs
short_comment: Suggs (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Grizzlies, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
long_comment: Suggs has been under the weather for a few days and will miss Orlando's preseason opener, along with Anthony Black (ankle), which sends second-year guard Jase Richardson into the starting lineup. Suggs will have three more chances to suit up during the preseason, with his first opportunity coming Sunday in Cleveland.

name: Jonathan Isaac
short_comment: Isaac (knee) won't travel with the Magic for Wednesday's preseason opener against the Grizzlies due to personal reasons, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
long_comment: Isaac also wasn't spotted on the court during the media-viewing portions of Orlando's practices Monday or Tuesday. The veteran forward entered training camp limited while completing his recovery from the left knee sprain that ended his 2025-26 campaign, but his absence Wednesday is being attributed to personal reasons.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
short_comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
long_comment: With Nelson still in recovery mode from the left ankle surgery he underwent this summer, his path back to game action remains delayed for the early part of the season. The rookie big man is on a two-way contract with the Magic, so his short-term absence mainly affects his developmental timeline rather than Orlando's regular rotation.

name: Dominick Barlow
short_comment: Barlow (back) isn't expected to play in either of Philadelphia's next two preseason games against Brooklyn and Boston, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.
long_comment: Barlow also missed Monday's preseason opener against New York due to the back issue. His next opportunity to make his preseason debut will come Oct. 16 against Boston.

name: Anfernee Simons
short_comment: Simons (right hamstring) isn't expected to play in either of Philadelphia's next two preseason games against Brooklyn and Boston, Dave McMenamin of ESPN reports.
long_comment: Simons also missed Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks due to the injury. His next opportunity to make his preseason debut will come Oct. 16 against Boston.

name: Adem Bona
short_comment: Bona (left foot) isn't expected to play in either of Philadelphia's next two preseason games against Brooklyn and Boston, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.
long_comment: Bona has yet to practice during training camp while recovering from the foot injury he suffered during FIBA competition. With Ariel Hukporti (Achilles) out indefinitely, Philadelphia will be particularly thin at center until Bona is cleared to return.

name: Ariel Hukporti
short_comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
long_comment: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid once healthy.

name: Tacko Fall
short_comment: Fall was diagnosed with a left hip strain Thursday and will miss at least two weeks, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.
long_comment: This is a tough blow for Fall, as he's already facing an uphill battle to make the final roster. A return Oct. 16 isn't out of the question based on this timetable.

name: Miles Bridges
short_comment: Bridges exited Wednesday's 124-117 preseason loss to the Bulls with a right ankle injury and did not return, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
long_comment: Bridges got tangled up fighting for a loose ball and tweaked his ankle, and while he initially tried to play through it, he retreated to the locker room a few possessions later. According to Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic, head coach Jordan Ott said after the game that he believes Bridges is "fine" and thinks there's a chance he could play in Saturday's exhibition against the Spurs.

name: Mark Williams
short_comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
long_comment: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With his status for Opening Night in jeopardy, this will put a lot of eyes on Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach, with the latter already drawing buzz during the Summer League. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
short_comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
long_comment: It's a tough blow to the Trail Blazers' depth on the wing ahead of training camp. Sharpe, who is now likely to be sidelined until after the All-Star break, had been ticketed for a reserve role behind Toumani Camara following an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign, which saw average a career-high 20.8 points, 1.4 steals and 2.1 three-pointers per game over 50 regular-season appearances. The door is now open for Vit Krejci and Jeremy Sochan to compete for bench minutes during camp.

name: Leaky Black
short_comment: Black (face) exited to the locker room in the fourth quarter of Thursday's 114-110 preseason loss to the Lakers and did not return, finishing with four points (2-2 FG), two rebounds, one assist and one steal across 11 minutes.
long_comment: Black took a shot to the face and appeared to have been poked in the eye. He can be considered questionable for Saturday's exhibition against Golden State until the Kings offer an update on his status.

name: Domantas Sabonis
short_comment: Sabonis (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason matchup with the Lakers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
long_comment: After supplying four points (1-2 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 2-2 FT), three rebounds and three assists in 10 minutes during Monday's preseason-opening loss to the Lakers, Sabonis will be held out of Thursday's contest for undisclosed reasons. The big man's next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come Saturday against Golden State.

name: Keegan Murray
short_comment: Murray (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Lakers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
long_comment: Murray appears to be dealing with some kind of injury, though the team has yet to provide any additional details. He can continue to be considered day-to-day leading up to Saturday's exhibition against the Warriors.

name: Malik Monk
short_comment: Monk (rest) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Lakers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
long_comment: Monk didn't play in Monday's game against the Lakers, and he won't suit up for the rematch as well. His next chance to feature will come against the Warriors on Saturday.

name: Ben Simmons
short_comment: Simmons (not injury related) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Lakers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
long_comment: Simmons is not yet ready to make his preseason debut. However, it seems he's in line to take the court for Sacramento's upcoming exhibition Saturday against the Warriors, per Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com. The Kings should have a better idea of his status for Saturday as tipoff nears.

name: Malik Williams
short_comment: Williams (undisclosed) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Hawks, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
long_comment: Williams won't be an option for this contest, but the big man isn't likely to play a big role with the Spurs anytime soon. He's expected to play for the Austin Spurs in the G League in the 2026-27 campaign. His next chance to play in the preseason will come against the Suns on Saturday.

name: De'Aaron Fox
short_comment: Fox won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Hawks due to soreness, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
long_comment: It's unclear exactly what is bothering Fox, though he was a late scratch due to soreness. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Saturday against the Suns.

name: Maliq Brown
short_comment: Brown (back) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Hawks, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
long_comment: Brown is dealing with some tightness, so this sounds like a precaution. The No. 44 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft is not expected to crack the rotation on Opening Night.

name: Jayden Quaintance
short_comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
long_comment: The Spurs are expected to exercise extreme caution with the big man, as Quaintance suffered a torn ACL and meniscus with Arizona State in February 2025 before appearing in only four games with Kentucky last season due to severe complications and persistent swelling. The 19-year-old underwent a cleanup procedure on his meniscus in mid-July, and the Spurs will likely want him at 100 percent before ramping him up to basketball activities.

name: Tobias Harris
short_comment: Spurs head coach Mitch Johnson said they will not rush Tobias Harris (calf) back to the court, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
long_comment: "It's a calf strain, the seriousness is what it is," said Johnson. "We won't rush him at all. I guess the question will be is he ready for the season opener? Totally questionable and we will not push that at all. So, we'll take it slow. There is no concern of this level of seriousness, and at the same time, we will not rush him at all." It sounds like Harris, who has already been ruled out for the preseason, is in danger of missing opening night. His absence will open up minutes for Julian Champagnie, Keldon Johnson and Harrison Barnes.

name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
short_comment: Correcting a previous report, Jackson-Davis (migraines) was absent from Tuesday's practice, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
long_comment: Jackson-Davis also missed Saturday's preseason opener against Miami, and it's unclear what's keeping him sidelined. His status will be worth monitoring ahead of Saturday's preseason matchup with the Clippers.

name: Jamison Battle
short_comment: Battle (lower back) was a limited participant in Monday's practice, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
long_comment: The severity of the lower-back issue is unclear, though it kept Battle out of last Saturday's preseason-opening loss to the Heat. He'll look to continue making progress in practices ahead of Saturday's preseason matchup with the Clippers.

name: Allen Graves
short_comment: Graves (groin) was limited during Sunday's practice, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
long_comment: Graves tweaked his groin earlier in training camp and was held out of Saturday's preseason opener against Miami. The rookie remains day-to-day, with Toronto's next preseason game coming Saturday against the Clippers.

name: Kawhi Leonard
short_comment: Leonard (not injury related) went through a full practice Monday, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
long_comment: This was Leonard's first full practice since training camp opened. He's expected to be held out of his second straight preseason contest Saturday, but it seems safe to say he will be a full go by Opening Night.

name: Nate Bittle
short_comment: Bittle (foot) did not play in Saturday's 129-105 preseason loss to the Heat.
long_comment: Bittle is dealing with a foot injury. He's been wearing a walking boot, so it's unknown if he will be cleared for action against the Clippers on Oct. 10.

name: Jusuf Nurkic
short_comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.
long_comment: Nurkic will begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines, and given the tricky nature of foot injuries for big men, it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond this initial four-week window. Jaren Jackson will likely spend more time at center while Nurkic is out, and there will be more minutes available for Jaxson Hayes and Mo Bamba.

name: Lauri Markkanen
short_comment: Markkanen won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nuggets due to neck soreness.
long_comment: Markkanen is sitting out an exhibition game with some minor neck soreness, but he should be able to get back out there for Monday's preseason game against the Spurs. Ace Bailey will have a chance to start sans Markkanen, and there will be more minutes available for Svi Mykhailiuk.

name: Brice Sensabaugh
short_comment: Sensabaugh (hip) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nuggets.
long_comment: A left hip injury will keep Sensabaugh off the floor for the rematch with Denver. The Jazz will likely be cautious with the 22-year-old, so it's reasonable to believe he could also miss Monday's exhibition versus the Spurs.

name: Kyle Filipowski
short_comment: Filipowski (back) is out for Tuesday's exhibition versus the Nuggets.
long_comment: Filipowski has yet to play or practice since the preseason began on Oct. 4. His next chance to suit up will come next Monday against the Spurs.

name: Khris Middleton
short_comment: Middleton (rest) is trending in the right direction for Saturday's preseason game against Detroit, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
long_comment: Middleton is being eased into action to begin the year. His status remains up in the air for Saturday's exhibition.

name: Alex Sarr
short_comment: Wizards head coach Brian Keefe said Friday that Sarr (foot) is trending in a positive direction regarding his availability, though his status for Saturday's preseason game remains uncertain, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
long_comment: Keefe indicated that a decision on Sarr's availability will be made Saturday, suggesting the big man could be nearing a return to game action. Even if Sarr is cleared to play, Washington could manage his workload during the preseason.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
short_comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
long_comment: Although the big man will remain a limited participant in training camp as he continues his rehab from a hip impingement, it sounds like his absence from game action will extend into the regular season. Deandre Ayton should have the backup center role all to himself until Vukcevic is cleared to retake the floor.

name: Jamir Watkins
short_comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
long_comment: Watkins, a two-way player for the Wizards, suffered the injury during the Summer League. Although Washington has yet to offer a timetable for a return, a typical recovery time for the procedure is approximately 9-to-12 months. That leaves Watkins in serious jeopardy of missing most, if not all, of the 2026-27 season, and it remains to be seen if the team will continue keeping him around on a two-way roster spot while he's injured.

name: Tre Jones
short_comment: Jones (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
long_comment: Jones is still considered day-to-day due to a left hip injury, with his next chance to play coming in Sunday's exhibition against Denver. In the meantime, Dailyn Swain and Jordan Hawkins could see increased playing time.

name: Jalen Smith
short_comment: Smith (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
long_comment: Smith is dealing with left foot soreness, and his next chance to suit up will come in Sunday's exhibition against Denver. With Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Zach Collins (toe) also out, Tobe Awaka and Leonard Miller figure to see increased burn Friday.

name: Zach Collins
short_comment: Collins (toe) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
long_comment: Collins is sitting out this exhibition but is nearing a return to the floor. The big man's next opportunity to suit up comes Sunday in Denver.

name: Jaylin Sellers
short_comment: Sellers (back) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
long_comment: Sellers continues to nurse lower-back soreness. His next chance to play comes Sunday in Denver.

name: Larry Nance Jr.
short_comment: Nance (hamstring) practiced Friday, per Tony East of Forbes.com.
long_comment: Nance has a chance to make his preseason debut Saturday against the Hawks. The veteran big man signed a one-year deal with the Pacers over the summer and is penciled in as the No. 2 center behind Ivica Zubac.

name: Isaiah Stewart
short_comment: Stewart (ankle) didn't practice Friday, per Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site.
long_comment: Stewart appears to be doubtful for Friday's preseason game in Chicago. He's recovering from a left ankle injury suffered in Memphis' preseason opener.

name: Anthony Black
short_comment: Black (ankle) was a full participant in Friday's practice, per Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel.
long_comment: Black sounds to be making good progress in his recovery from a right ankle sprain. The fourth-year guard has a chance to make his preseason debut Sunday against Cleveland as he prepares to occupy the sixth man role for Orlando this season.

name: Miles Bridges
short_comment: Head coach Jordan Ott said Friday that Bridges' X-rays came back negative, and he participated in Friday's practice, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
long_comment: Bridges exited Wednesday's preseason loss to the Bulls with a right ankle injury and did not return, though this news bodes well for his status ahead of the regular season. Ott added that the team will "be smart" with Bridges moving forward, so it wouldn't be surprising if he missed time during the preseason. The 28-year-old forward can be considered questionable for Saturday's exhibition against San Antonio until the Suns provide an update.

name: Matas Buzelis
short_comment: Buzelis exited to the locker room in the second quarter and will not return to Friday's preseason game against the Grizzlies due to a right ankle injury, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports. He'll finish with six points (3-6 FG, 0-2 3Pt) and one block in 12 minutes.
long_comment: Buzelis appeared to twist his ankle earlier in the game but initially played through the injury. His status will be worth monitoring ahead of Sunday's exhibition against Denver. With the 2024 first-rounder out for the remainder of the game, Dailyn Swain and Leonard Miller could see increased playing time.

name: Isaiah Stewart
short_comment: The Grizzlies announced Friday that Stewart (ankle) will miss at least two weeks.
long_comment: Stewart, who was traded from Detroit to Memphis over the summer, sustained a left ankle sprain in the team's preseason opener and is now likely to miss Opening Night. His absence opens the door for Quinten Post to move into the backup center role behind Zach Edey in the interim.

name: Kawhi Leonard
short_comment: Leonard (not injury related) won't suit up for Saturday's exhibition against the Clippers, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports.
long_comment: Leonard will miss a second straight preseason game while ramping up his workload following the offseason, but he's not dealing with an injury. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Tuesday against the Knicks.

name: Micah Peavy
short_comment: Peavy (ankle) did not see the floor in Friday's 104-100 preseason win over the Bulls.
long_comment: Peavy missed a third consecutive contest due to an ankle injury. His final chance to play in the preseason will come next Friday against Charlotte.
